about.description: A user skin manager for War Thunder. Browse WT Live, install with a click, keep your hangar tidy.
about.privacy: No account, no ads, no telemetry. Livery connects only to WT Live (live.warthunder.com and its image server) when you browse or install skins, and to GitHub to check for updates. Your settings and library stay on this PC. It reads the game’s files and the lineups in your War Thunder profile without changing them. “Send feedback” only opens a GitHub page in your browser: nothing is sent until you submit it there. If you use Remove background in Atelier, Livery downloads its files from GitHub once, only when you ask; your pictures stay on this PC.
about.feedbackHint: Report a bug or suggest an idea on GitHub
